article.title: THE THIRD SCHEDULE
article.content: In sub-section (6) of section 178, after the words “for the time being in force”, the words and figures “except the provisions of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016” shall be inserted.
article.html:
The Third Schedule

(See section 247) · page 157 of the Act

Amendment to the Income-tax Act, 1961 (43 of 1961)

In sub-section (6) of section 178, after the words “for the time being in force”, the words and figures “except the provisions of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016” shall be inserted.
